recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-18392 unless a future publisher/template regression reintroduces a bottom-positioned local table-of-contents on this page.
issue_request: FHIR-18392 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 as a non-substantive technical correction. It asked to correct the "On This Page" menu on the extensibility examples page because the menu for the sliceextensions2 section was appearing at the bottom rather than the top.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by Grahame Grieve's 2018-10-13 commit a0224fc031511620b84439829f0eb723a7796a15, whose message names GF#18392. That commit removed the hand-authored bottom-of-page `[%onthispage Patient Consent#consent|Name Parts#name-parts|Complex Extension#complex%]` macro from `source/extensibility-examples.html`.
additional_context: `source/extensibility-examples.html` remains in current build scope through the active Extensibility hierarchy entry and `publish.ini`. The current source still contains the `sliceextensions2` section but contains no `[%onthispage ...%]` macro, so there is no remaining bottom-positioned menu source to move. The same historical commit also applied FHIR-18373's separate consent wording/link correction, but that request is distinct and was not decided here. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the requested menu-location correction is already present in the authoritative current source.

related_jiras.note: The same 2018 source commit also applied a separate consent wording/link correction on source/extensibility-examples.html, but that request is distinct from the menu-placement issue.
